exposure: Hemolysis, Elevated Liver Enzymes, Low Platelet count syndrome
outcome: prevalence of Hemolysis, Elevated Liver Enzymes, Low Platelet count syndrome
cohort: Patients who delivered at a tertiary care hospital from April 1, 2017 to March 30, 2018
finding: The prevalence of Hemolysis, Elevated Liver Enzymes, Low Platelet count syndrome was 0.69% (83 out of 11,974 deliveries), and was associated with maternal complications (22.9%), including acute renal failure (47.37%), postpartum hemorrhage (21.05%), need for maternal ICU stay (33%), and one maternal mortality.
